description: MainActivity.kt defines the primary UI and logic for a note-taking Android application. It manages displaying, creating, editing, deleting, and searching notes stored locally in SharedPreferences, utilizing RecyclerView to show notes and dialogs for note input.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity class handling the note-taking UI and data persistence.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter class responsible for displaying notes in the list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, loads notes, and prepares the list and search functionality.

methods.name: showNoteDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create a new note or edit an existing one.

methods.name: showDeleteDialog
methods.description: Prompts confirmation to delete a selected note.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from SharedPreferences and initializes the notes list.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Serializes the notes list into JSON and saves it to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters notes based on a search query and updates the display.

methods.name: updateNotesView
methods.description: Refreshes the RecyclerView and visibility of the 'no notes' message.

methods.name: generateNoteId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID for a note.
